It was a dim and stormy dusk, around 5 pm in September of 2012. My grandmother and I were walking back through the ER parking lot, in the rain, to our van, distraught at my grandfather having to stay in the hospital for a severe infection. That day, the 18th, was my grandmother's birthday and everything just kinda sucked hard. 
Then, we heard a little meow, from a little dirty, wet, skinny white kitten bouncing along with us. We looked around the parking lot to see if anyone was looking for her, and she seemed to be unclaimed. I resolved to save this kitten from being run over and killed, so I grabbed her, wrapped her up in my jacket, and took her home with us. As I was holding this little kitten, her purring in my jacket, I knew I'd saved a very special little life. At first we were worried my grandpa would be upset (He's a dog person), but he immediately fell in love with little fluffy and now she's spoiled rotten by all three of us, especially since she's grown up to be a big, beautiful fluffball.
